audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Shane’s entire cliffside mental-health crisis and hospital follow-up and Vincent and Jas’s complete spring-onion lesson. Every line, intervention choice, self-harm statement, medical explanation, hope message, child joke, gender branch, bug-care instruction, reward message, and item reference was reviewed in full event context with consistent Spring Onion and Zuzu City terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, forks and response IDs, reward state, placeholders, gender and dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Forest record and full-locale final audits remain pending.
